fusions.name: Shut Mouth
fusions.desc: Your tongue hits the first enemy in its path up to 5 tiles away for 12 damage and holds it: it is stunned for 1 second and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Glue Trap
fusions.desc: Sticky secretion spreads around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars Drop
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and hops you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Caught Is Kept
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
